messages:
Nina: Heads-up: found a broken endpoint in the quickstart deploy snippet. It posts to /v0/generate but our public API is /v1/generate now. Filing a tiny patch.
Marta: Ugh, thanks. Which file? I can patch the text too.
Nina: /get-started/quickstart/index.md. Also noticed the Node example is using the old SDK import path (sdk-old). We should add a short migration note for v4->v5.
Theo: Can you include a short one-liner for env var naming? Some of our snippets still use REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY. Recommend REDWOOD_KEY.
Nina: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 (WIP)  updates endpoint, adds migration note, and bumps the Node snippet.
DocBot: PR #512 opened by Nina  status: CI queued  reviewers: @Marta, @Ben
Ben: I'll run snippet-run locally. Last time the Python sample failed because the snippet-run runner used python2.7 image. We should pin python:3 in the snippet metadata.
Priya: Good catch. Also some inline code blocks show WINDOWS style line endings in the curl example — markdown-lint flagged it.
Marta: I can fix the CRLFs. For migration note: short paragraph: "If you're upgrading from SDK v4, update imports from sdk_old to @redwood/sdk and switch to client.open_stream() for streaming outputs." Keep it tiny.
Theo: Add an example diff block so people can copy/paste. Two lines max.
Nina: Adding diff now. Proposed diff:
```diff
- const { Client } = require('sdk-old')
- const client = new Client(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
+ const { Client } = require('@redwood/sdk')
+ const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
```
Ben: Ran snippet-run after adding python:3 pin and fixed curl CRLFs. One failing test left: the Node snippet uses top-level await and our node image is 12.x. Need to switch the snippet metadata to node:16 or wrap in async IIFE.
Priya: Prefer updating the metadata to node:18 so it's future-proof. Also append a note: "If your environment uses older Node, wrap in an async function."
Marta: Ok I'll update PR with node:18 and the small note. Nina, can you also add a redirect from /v0/generate to /v1/generate in the docs link so old bookmarks don't 404?
Nina: I added an internal alias in the frontmatter to avoid 404s.
DocBot: CI running for PR #512  checks: markdown-lint, link-check, snippet-run (node:18, python:3)
Ben: CI failed on snippet-run: node snippet timed out on the streaming example. The runner's timeout is 10s; streaming example waits for user input. Suggest we modify snippet to complete automatically, or show a trimmed non-blocking example.
Marta: Let's show a non-interactive example for quickstart and link to the streaming guide for advanced usage. I'll replace with a simple generate call.
Theo: Also add a one-line note about cold-start: "For quickstarts, prefer rwd-1-small to reduce model init time."
Nina: Updated PR: replaced streaming example with non-interactive generate, set node:18, added migration diff and alias, fixed CRLFs. Ready for review.
Marta: Reviewing now. Two very small copy edits in the migration note, then merge.
DocBot: CI passed for PR #512  status: green  mergeable: true
Marta: Merged by Marta  commit: a1b2c3d  docs site build triggered
Ben: Verified the snippet-run in prod build logs looks clean. Thanks all.
Priya: Noted for next week: sweep other quickstarts for v0 references. Could be a tiny grep job.
Theo: I'll add a short ticket in the docs board to grep for /v0/ and REDWOOD_API_KEY across the repo.
Nina: Thanks team! Small win for onboarding UX. :tada:
